# LBM

# 1. Prepare data

## D1

```{r}
### 16S

ps_16S_rare_expe_D1 <- Charge_xl_to_ps("ps_16S_rare_expe_D1", folder_path=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1"))

ps_16S_rare_expe_D1 <- fix_all_taxa(phyloseq_object = ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, ranks = c("Family", "Genus"))

# Filter data (exclude host fruits)
ps_16S_rare_expe_D1 <- Subset_physeq(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, SampleType %in%  c("Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae","Pupae","Daughters"))

# counts -> presence/absence (binary table)
ps_rare_16S_D1_bin = phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, function(x) 1*(x>0)) 

## Extract metadata
mtd_D1_16S <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps_rare_16S_D1_bin))
mtd_D1_16S <- mtd_D1_16S %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sample = ID_pool)

## Extract taxonomy table
df_taxo_D1_16S = as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rare_16S_D1_bin))
df_taxo_D1_16S$tax_ID = rownames(df_taxo_D1_16S)

## Extract table with presence/absence
df_reads_D1_16S = as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_rare_16S_D1_bin)) 
df_reads_D1_16S = as.data.frame(df_reads_D1_16S)
df_reads_D1_16S$tax_ID = rownames(df_reads_D1_16S)
## Merge table with presence/absence and taxonomy
df_wide_D1_16S <- dplyr::left_join(df_taxo_D1_16S, df_reads_D1_16S, by = "tax_ID") #merge the two (suppr "Species" column)
df_wide_D1_16S$Species <- NULL

## Remove taxonomy other than Genus
BF_D1_16S <- df_wide_D1_16S[, c(6,8:dim(df_wide_D1_16S)[2])] #subset + genus as row names + sample names as column names + transposematrix
BF_D1_16S$Genus <- make.unique(BF_D1_16S$Genus, sep = "_")
rownames(BF_D1_16S) <- BF_D1_16S$Genus 
BF_D1_16S$Genus <- NULL
colnames(BF_D1_16S) <- mtd_D1_16S$Sample[match(colnames(BF_D1_16S), mtd_D1_16S$Sample)]
## Transpose matrix
FB_D1_16S <- t(BF_D1_16S)
## Export
write.csv(FB_D1_16S, file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data","5_SBMclustering", "Dataset_1", "FB_D1_16S.csv"), row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(mtd_D1_16S, file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data","5_SBMclustering", "Dataset_1", "mtd_D1_16S.csv"), row.names = TRUE)

Save_ps_as_xls(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, folder_path=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "5_SBMclustering", "Dataset_1")) 
```

#2. LBM clustering

## D1

### 16S

```{r}
#Charge matrix
FB_D1_16S <- read.csv(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data","5_SBMclustering", "Dataset_1", "FB_D1_16S.csv"),header=TRUE, sep=",", row.names = 1)

#LBM calculation
SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1 <-  as.matrix(FB_D1_16S) %>%
  sbm::estimateBipartiteSBM(model = 'bernoulli')

memb_spl_obs_16S_D1 <- SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1$memberships$row
memb_otu_obs_16S_D1 <- SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1$memberships$col

save(memb_spl_obs_16S_D1, memb_otu_obs_16S_D1, file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data","5_SBMclustering", "Dataset_1", "membership_vectors_16S_D1.RData"))

SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1$storedModels %>% dplyr::arrange(ICL)
 
#Plots
SBM_16S_D1_FruitType <- Order_Matrix_Plot2(SBMobject = SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1, BF_mat = BF_D1_16S, mtd = mtd_D1_16S, variable_name = "FruitType", modality_string = c("BL", "CH","na", "ST") , color_string = c("purple4", "red4","grey", "red2"), legend_name = "Fruit of Origin")   

title_plot <- "SBM_D1_16S_FruitType_ordered_F60.png"

cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "5_SBM&co", "Dataset_1", title_plot), SBM_16S_D1_FruitType, base_height = 20/cm(1),  base_width = 40/cm(1), dpi = 1200)


SBM_16S_D1_SampleType <- Order_Matrix_Plot2(SBMobject = SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1, BF_mat = BF_D1_16S, mtd = mtd_D1_16S, variable_name = "SampleType", modality_string = c( "Mothers_0days","Mothers_2days",  "Larvae", "Pupae",  "Daughters"), color_string = c( "goldenrod2", "#8B4500","red2", "red3","darkorange2"), legend_name = "Type of Sample")   

title_plot <- "SBM_D1_16S_SampleType_ordered_F60.png"

cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "5_SBM&co", "Dataset_1", title_plot), SBM_16S_D1_SampleType, base_height = 20/cm(1),  base_width = 40/cm(1), dpi = 1200)


SBM_16S_D1_FruitSite <- Order_Matrix_Plot2(SBMobject = SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1, BF_mat = BF_D1_16S, mtd = mtd_D1_16S, variable_name = "FruitSite", modality_string = c("FIN","IST","LOM","MIL","na","VAR"), color_string = c("skyblue", "blue2", "skyblue4","deepskyblue","grey","dodgerblue"), legend_name = "Fruit Sampling Site") #5 sites
                                           
title_plot <- "SBM_D1_16S_FruitSite_ordered_F60.png"

cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "5_SBM&co", "Dataset_1", title_plot), SBM_16S_D1_FruitSite, base_height = 20/cm(1),  base_width = 40/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

### ITS

```{r}
#Charge matrix
FB_D1_ITS <- read.csv(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data","5_SBMclustering", "Dataset_1", "FB_D1_ITS.csv"),header=TRUE, sep=",", row.names = 1)

# LBM calculation

SBM_bernoulli_ITS_D1$storedModels %>% dplyr::arrange(ICL)

# Plot
SBM_ITS_expe_FruitType <- Order_Matrix_Plot4(SBMobject = SBM_bernoulli_ITS_D1, BF_mat = BF_D1_ITS, mtd = mtd_D1_ITS, variable_name = "FruitType", modality_string = c("BL","CH","na",  "ST"), color_string = c("purple4", "red4","grey", "red2"), legend_name = "Fruit of Origin") 

title_plot <- "SBM_D1_ITS_FruitType_order1_F60.png"

 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "5_SBM&co", "Dataset_1", title_plot), SBM_ITS_expe_FruitType, base_height = 20/cm(1),  base_width = 40/cm(1), dpi = 1200)


SBM_ITS_expe_SampleType <- Order_Matrix_Plot4(SBMobject = SBM_bernoulli_ITS_D1, BF_mat = BF_D1_ITS, mtd = mtd_D1_ITS, variable_name = "SampleType", modality_string = c("Moters_0days", "Mothers_2days",  "Larvae", "Pupae",  "Daughters"), color_string = c("goldenrod2", "#8B4500","red2", "red3","darkorange2"), legend_name = "Type of Sample")

SBM_ITS_expe_FruitSite <- Order_Matrix_Plot4(SBMobject = SBM_bernoulli_ITS_D1, BF_mat = BF_D1_ITS, mtd = mtd_D1_ITS, variable_name = "FruitSite", modality_string = c("FIN","IST","LOM","MIL","na","VAR"), color_string = c("skyblue", "blue2", "skyblue4","deepskyblue","grey","dodgerblue"), legend_name = "Fruit Sampling Site") #5 sites
```

#3. Alluvial plot
## D1
### ITS
```{r}
# PREPARE DATA 

# Filter out Mothers_0days & host fruits
ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1 <- Subset_physeq(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1, SampleType %in%  c("Mothers_2days", "Larvae","Pupae","Daughters"))

# Create factor FruitType2 : BL or CH+ST
sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$FruitType2 <- ifelse(
  sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$FruitType %in% c("na", "BL"),
  sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$FruitType, "CH + ST")

# counts -> presence/absence (binary table)
ps_rare_ITS_D1_bin = phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1, function(x) 1*(x>0)) 

## Extract metadata
mtd_D1_ITS <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps_rare_ITS_D1_bin))
mtd_D1_ITS <- mtd_D1_ITS %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sample = ID_pool)

## Extract taxonomy table
df_taxo_D1_ITS = as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rare_ITS_D1_bin))
df_taxo_D1_ITS$tax_ID = rownames(df_taxo_D1_ITS)

## Extract table with presence/absence
df_reads_D1_ITS = as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_rare_ITS_D1_bin)) 
df_reads_D1_ITS = as.data.frame(df_reads_D1_ITS)
df_reads_D1_ITS$tax_ID = rownames(df_reads_D1_ITS)

## Merge table with presence/absence and taxonomy
df_wide_D1_ITS = dplyr::left_join(df_taxo_D1_ITS, df_reads_D1_ITS, by = "tax_ID") #merge the two (suppr "Species" column)
df_wide_D1_ITS$Species <- NULL

## Remove taxonomy other than Genus
BF_D1_ITS <- df_wide_D1_ITS[, c(6,8:dim(df_wide_D1_ITS)[2])] #subset + genus as row names + sample names as column names
BF_D1_ITS$Genus <- make.unique(BF_D1_ITS$Genus, sep = "_")
rownames(BF_D1_ITS) <- BF_D1_ITS$Genus 
BF_D1_ITS$Genus <- NULL
colnames(BF_D1_ITS) <- mtd_D1_ITS$Sample[match(colnames(BF_D1_ITS), mtd_D1_ITS$Sample)]
## Transpose matrix
FB_D1_ITS <- t(BF_D1_ITS)

# LBM calculation
SBM_bernoulli_ITS_D1 <-  as.matrix(FB_D1_ITS) %>%
    sbm::estimateBipartiteSBM(model = 'bernoulli')

memb_spl_obs_ITS_D1 <- SBM_bernoulli_ITS_D1$memberships$row
memb_otu_obs_ITS_D1 <- SBM_bernoulli_ITS_D1$memberships$col
```

```{r}
# data for alluvial plot (Freq = Number of samples associated with each line)
dataalluvial_ITS_D1 <-
  as.data.frame(table(
      memb_spl_obs_ITS_D1,
      sample_data(ps_rare_ITS_D1_bin)$FruitType))


# change column names
colnames(dataalluvial_ITS_D1) = c("FungalCom", "FruitType", "Freq")

# eliminate lines with zero Freq
w_D1_ITS_sample <- which(dataalluvial_ITS_D1$Freq != 0)
dataalluvial_ITS_D1 <- dataalluvial_ITS_D1[w_D1_ITS_sample, ]

# alluvial plot
Alluvial_ITS_D1_FruitType_sample <- ggplot(data = dataalluvial_ITS_D1,
       aes(axis1 = FungalCom, axis2 = FruitType, y = Freq)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Fungal Communities", "Fruit Type"), expand = c(.2, .05)) +
  ggalluvial::geom_alluvium(aes(fill = FruitType), alpha = 0.6) +
  ggalluvial::geom_stratum() +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
 scale_fill_manual(values = c("CH" = "red4", "ST" ="red2",  "BL" = "purple4"), guide = "none") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold"))

title_plot <- "AlluvialPlot_D1_ITS_FruitType.png"

cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "5_SBM&co", "Dataset_1", title_plot), Alluvial_ITS_D1_FruitType_sample, base_height = 20/cm(1),  base_width = 30/cm(1), dpi = 1200)




# data for alluvial plot (Freq = Number of samples associated with each line)
dataalluvial_ITS_D1_2 <-
  as.data.frame(table(
      memb_spl_obs_ITS_D1,
      sample_data(ps_rare_ITS_D1_bin)$FruitType2))

# change column names
colnames(dataalluvial_ITS_D1_2) = c("FungalCom", "FruitType", "Freq")

# eliminate lines with zero Freq
w_D1_ITS_sample <- which(dataalluvial_ITS_D1$Freq != 0)
dataalluvial_ITS_D1_2 <- dataalluvial_ITS_D1[w_D1_ITS_sample, ]

# alluvial plot
Alluvial_ITS_D1_FruitType2 <- ggplot(data = dataalluvial_ITS_D1_2,
       aes(axis1 = FungalCom, axis2 = FruitType, y = Freq)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Fungal Communities", "Fruit Type"), expand = c(.2, .05)) +
  ggalluvial::geom_alluvium(aes(fill = FruitType), alpha = 0.6) +
  ggalluvial::geom_stratum() +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
 scale_fill_manual(values = c("CH + ST" = "red4", "BL" = "purple4"), guide = "none") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold"))

title_plot <- "AlluvialPlot_D1_ITS_FruitType2.png"

cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "5_SBM&co", "Dataset_1", title_plot), Alluvial_ITS_D1_FruitType2, base_height = 20/cm(1),  base_width = 30/cm(1), dpi = 1200)

# Combined plot
AlluvPlot_combined <- 
  (Alluvial_ITS_D1_FruitType_sample + labs(tag = "A. Initial Fruit Types")) /
  (Alluvial_ITS_D1_FruitType2 + labs(tag = "B. Grouped Fruit Types")) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1) & theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.tag = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

title_plot <- "AlluvialPlots_combined.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "5_SBM&co", "Dataset_1", title_plot), AlluvPlot_combined, base_height = 26/cm(1),  base_width = 34.7/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```
